summary: Deflake two-process source reconciliation test in required CI smoke acceptance by moving app construction before readiness, adopting two-barrier ready/race synchronization with generous timeouts, surfacing dying worker tracebacks, and removing second-boundary fetch config drift.

failing_run.failure_symptom: test_two_process_workers_create_one_connector_schedule_run_and_source_record failed with threading.BrokenBarrierError after 30s timeout while worker 2 was still importing/initializing.

incident_context.root_cause_analysis: In Python multiprocessing spawn mode, spawned workers do not inherit memory/imports via fork; each child independently bootstraps Python and loads heavy libraries (FastAPI, pydantic, services.source_ingestion.main) from scratch. On a loaded runner with CPU contention, worker 1 completed initialization and entered barrier.wait(timeout=30) while worker 2 was delayed by startup overhead and cold imports, exceeding 30s. Additionally, any pre-barrier failure in one worker caused the other worker to hang until timeout and masked the root cause with BrokenBarrierError. Furthermore, dynamic datetime.now() in MultiprocessProvider.fetch_config() caused intermittent second-boundary config drift resulting in unexpected reconciliation mutations.
incident_context.resolution: 1) Pre-import test client and connector fixtures at top-level; 2) construct app and TestClient context prior to signalling readiness; 3) implement ready_barrier (120s timeout) for startup skew tolerance and race_barrier (60s timeout) for simultaneous controller race; 4) abort barriers on child exception so peer worker unblocks immediately; 5) surface dying worker's own traceback prominently in parent assertions; 6) use fixed deterministic available_time in test fixture.

acceptance_verification.ac1_evidence_cites_ci_failure_and_explai: passed: cited run 37781263393 attempt 1 (job 113325459871) BrokenBarrierError and attempt 2 passing rerun; detailed cold spawn import latency skew and second-boundary fetch drift root causes.
acceptance_verification.ac2_workers_race_same_reconcile_and_cont: passed: both workers synchronize on ready_barrier then race simultaneously through race_barrier; single connector schedule run and single source record guarantees verified.
acceptance_verification.ac3_bounded_generous_waits_and_child_tra: passed: ready_barrier (120s) and race_barrier (60s) tolerate slow runners without unbounded waits; pre-barrier worker failure aborts barriers and parent reports primary root-cause traceback; verified with test_worker_failure_before_barrier_surfaces_own_traceback.
acceptance_verification.ac4_repeated_passes_under_cpu_contention: passed: ran 5 consecutive iterations under 4 CPU burner processes locally with 100% pass rate; no test skipped or removed.
acceptance_verification.ac5_exact_reviewed_head_ready: passed: scoped artifacts limited to test_multi_process_source_reconciliation.py and task evidence.json.
